items.title: 20.3 Benzene ki reactivity ka alkanes aur alkenes se muqabla (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.3 with Quick Check 20.3 answered, printed page 61.

blocks.text: Alkanes aam taur par kam reactive (kam react karne wale) organic compounds hain, kyun ke yeh non-polar hain aur in mein sirf sigma bonds hain. Phir bhi UV roshni mein yeh kaafi aasani se free radical substitution reactions karte hain. Doosri taraf alkenes bohat reactive hain, kyun ke in mein π bond hai aur is ke π electrons electrophilic reagents (electron pasand karne wale reagents) ke liye mojood hain. Alkenes aasani se electrophilic addition reactions karte hain.
Benzene mein teen π bonds hain, is liye ummeed ke mutabiq yeh bhi alkenes ki tarah electrophiles se react karta hai. Lekin electrophiles ke saath in ke reactions mein do bare farq hain:

items: benzene bohat stable hai, is liye kam reactive hai.
alkenes ke baraks (unlike) yeh electrophilic substitution karta hai, electrophilic addition nahi:

blocks.alt: Baen, electrophilic substitution: benzene (us ka H numayan), teer ke oopar Br2 aur neeche FeBr3, se bromobenzene + HBr; H ki jagah Br aa gaya. Daen, electrophilic addition: cyclohexene jis ke double bond wale har carbon par H hai, Br2 ke saath 1,2-dibromocyclohexane deta hai, ab un dono carbons par H aur Br; double bond par do Br jur gaye.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki electrophilic substitution aur cyclohexene par electrophilic addition (kitab ke PDF safha 64 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Benzene mein Br ek H ki jagah le leta hai aur aromatic ring bachi rehti hai (substitution). Cyclohexene mein do Br atoms double bond par jur jate hain (addition). Kitab cyclohexene wale arrow par laal cross (X) lagati hai, jaise yeh reaction hota hi na ho; asal mein cyclohexene bromine se aasani se addition karta hai. Kitab ka matlab yeh hai ke benzene yeh addition nahi karta; is liye yahan arrow baghair cross ke bana hai.

blocks.caption: Bromine ka benzene aur cyclohexene se reaction
rows: Br₂ ke saath FeBr₃ (ya AlBr₃) catalyst
ring aromatic thi hi nahi; double bond khatam

blocks.text: Electrophilic substitution mein bromine ek hydrogen atom ki jagah leta hai. Is ki wajah aromatic ring ki stability hai, jo π electrons ki wasee (extensive) delocalization se aati hai. Reaction ek intermediate (beech ki halat) se guzarta hai jis mein aromaticity toot jati hai, lekin reaction mukammal hone par wapas aa jati hai. Is liye electrophilic substitution benzene ring ki kul stability ko kharab nahi karti. Electrophilic addition mein delocalisation hamesha ke liye toot jati hai, is liye addition pasandeeda (favourable) nahi.

blocks.prompt: Benzene bohat unsaturated hai, phir bhi addition reactions pasand nahi karta. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Addition delocalised π system ko tor deta aur resonance energy (taqreeban 152 kJ mol⁻¹) zaya ho jati, is liye energy ke lihaz se yeh nuqsan ka sauda hai. Substitution mein aakhir mein ring ki aromaticity wapas aa jati hai, is liye benzene substitution karta hai.

items: Alkanes: kam reactive; UV roshni mein free radical substitution.
Benzene: stable; electrophilic substitution, jis mein aromatic ring bachi rehti hai.
